description:
Add the performance-path encoding APIs: allocation-free single-codeword `encode_into`, reusable-workspace batch methods, and shared-parallel batch execution over supported worker counts, alongside the allocating conveniences.

## Background

The current batch encoder is a sequential map; large-batch throughput requires real multi-worker execution with deterministic ordered output and per-worker workspace partitioning, following the repository's parallel and determinism conventions.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `encode_into` and workspace batch methods produce results identical to the allocating paths without per-call allocation on the hot path; buffer-size mismatches report the coding-general error layer.
- [hard] REQ-02: Batch encoding supports worker counts greater than one with deterministic, input-ordered output, workspace partitioning per worker, and identical results across supported worker counts.
title: Allocation-free single, workspace batch, and parallel batch encoding
